approach.summary: Forward raw webhook values through the injected Transformer exactly once, preserving result and error identity and observer ordering.
rules: Pass the original input directly to Transform exactly once; never trim, uppercase, coerce, retry, recover panics, or replace values.
Call Started before Transform when observer is non-nil; call Finished with the original result only when the error is nil.
Return the original result and original error unchanged, including a non-nil result on failure.

title: Event forwarding adapters
goal: Deliver raw events through injected services with observer ordering
constraints: Delegate raw values exactly once; do not normalize or coerce
Observer started before service; finished only on success
required_verification: Service substitution, error identity, and observer ordering tests
